title: security(rbac-v2): KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: customers require stronger guarantees and visibility around KMS key residency when RBAC v2 policies enforce regional constraints. This PR augments the RBAC v2 policy schema to support explicit kms_region pinning, emits structured audit events for KMS operations (including key id, region_hint, and policy_source), and hardens enforcement checks in the policy evaluator. Changes include schema migrations, API contract updates, audit log plumbing, and migration tooling for existing policies. Checklist: - [x] Schema changes and migration script - [x] Policy evaluator enforcement with region fallback semantics - [x] Emit structured audit events for all KMS operations - [x] Backwards-compatible defaults for policies without kms_region - [x] Unit + integration tests + feature flag behind rbac_v2_kms_audit toggle - [x] Documentation snippets in redwood-docs (link to docs PR TBD) Notes: This PR is intentionally scoped to server-side policy handling and audit emission; KMS provider integrations (cloud SDKs) are unchanged except for new metadata fields passed through the KMS client wrapper.

Ava Chen: Added exponential backoff retry and comment. Also added a note to the test explaining emulator flakiness. Rerunning CI now.
Liam O'Connor: Approve after addressing minor nits in audit payload naming (region_hint -> kms_region_hint).

Migration: Includes script to migrate existing policies to include region hints when available. Backout instructions provided.
